description:
Get the properties and relationships of a hostSslCertificate object.

TIP: Lists SSL certificates observed on hosts. Each has host, sslCertificate (issuer, subject, serialNumber, sha256, validityPeriod), firstSeenDateTime, lastSeenDateTime. Useful for tracking certificate changes and detecting suspicious certificates.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-threat-intel-ssl-certs
